title: A New Approach to Linear Filtering and Prediction Problems
annotation: The seminal paper establishing the discrete-time recursive state-space Kalman filter under minimum mean-square error criteria.

title: Simple Online and Realtime Tracking
authors: Alex Bewley, Zongyuan Ge, Lionel Ott, Fabio Ramos, Ben Upcroft
publisher: IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP)
annotation: Foundational tracking-by-detection paper establishing SORT with Kalman kinematics and Hungarian bipartite matching.

title: Simple Online and Realtime Tracking with a Deep Association Metric
authors: Nicolai Wojke, Alex Bewley, Dietrich Paulus
publisher: IEEE International Conference on Image Processing (ICIP)
annotation: Introduces deep visual appearance embeddings (ReID) and cascading association to reduce ID switches under occlusion.

title: ByteTrack: Multi-Object Tracking by Associating Every Detection Box
authors: Yifu Zhang, Peize Sun, Yi Jiang, Dongdong Yu, Fucheng Weng, Zehuan Yuan, Ping Luo, Wenyu Liu, Xinggang Wang
annotation: State-of-the-art MOT paradigm associating both high-confidence and low-confidence detection boxes to recover occluded targets.

title: HOTA: A Higher Order Metric for Evaluating Multi-Object Tracking
authors: Jonathon Luiten, Aljosa Osep, Patrick Dendorfer, Philip Torr, Andreas Geiger, Laura Leal-Taixe, Bastian Leibe
annotation: Establishes the unified HOTA evaluation metric, formally decoupling detection accuracy from temporal association accuracy.
